Amalfi Foods is looking for an experienced FMCG salesperson to open and grow supermarket and hypermarket accounts across the GCC, with Bahrain, Saudi Arabia and the UAE as initial priorities.

You will work directly with retail buyers and category managers to secure listings for Amalfi’s bakery products, negotiate commercial terms, and coordinate with distributors and local teams to get products onto shelves and generate repeat orders. You should already know how modern trade works in the GCC.
Identify priority retail chains in each market, build relationships with buyers and category managers, and develop a sales pipeline from first meeting through launch.
Negotiate listings, pricing, listing fees, rebates, payment terms and promotional plans within agreed commercial limits.
Coordinate with distributors and local sales teams to complete vendor setup, secure first orders, and agree rollout dates and opening quantities by branch.

Visit stores to check product availability, shelf placement, stock rotation and promotional execution. Use sell-through and returns data, where available, to adjust order quantities and replenishment frequency.
Grow existing accounts by adding branches and products based on sales performance and buyer feedback.
Share account forecasts and promotional plans with production and logistics. Follow up with finance and distribution partners on overdue payments and account deductions.
Report weekly on sales, listings, branches live, repeat orders, returns and account profitability.
At least five years of FMCG food sales experience , with direct experience selling to supermarket or hypermarket buyers in at least two GCC markets .

Strong commercial negotiation, sales reporting and follow-up skills.

Net sales and account profitability after trade spend.
New accounts opened and product listings secured.
Active branches, on-shelf availability and repeat orders.
